scripts.build: pnpm build:packs && nx run-many -t build && pnpm build:schema
scripts.e2e:build:variants: env -u VITE_ROUTE_BASE_PATH -u VITE_GITHUB_PAGES -u PUBLIC_URL pnpm --filter @aws/threat-composer-app run compile:browser-extension && env -u VITE_ROUTE_BASE_PATH -u VITE_GITHUB_PAGES -u PUBLIC_URL pnpm --filter @aws/threat-composer-app run compile:ide-extension
scripts.generate:attribution: git secrets --scan && generate-attribution && mv oss-attribution/attribution.txt LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY
scripts.postinstall: command -v uv > /dev/null && (cd packages/threat-composer-ai && uv sync) || echo 'uv not found on PATH; skipping packages/threat-composer-ai sync'
scripts.upgrade-deps: pnpm exec npm-check-updates --deep --rejectVersion 0.0.0 -u --dep prod,dev,peer,optional --target=minor && rm -f pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm install

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: pnpm does not run a dependency build script unless it is listed here. Keep this minimal: each entry is a package that needs a postinstall to produce a working binary.
pnpm.//overrides: Security pins carried over from the yarn resolutions block, plus two scoped entries added to close the last two Dependabot alerts. brace-expansion@>=5 is scoped rather than global: three major lines are live at once (1.x, 2.x, 5.x), all patched, and a global pin would force incompatible majors on some consumers -- only the 5.x line needed moving, from 5.0.8 to 5.0.9, and it is nx that pulls it in through minimatch. @aws-northstar/ui>uuid is scoped to that one consumer, which still asks for uuid 9; everything else in the tree is already on 14. Both were verified against the repository's open Dependabot alerts, and the whole suite passes with them applied.
